newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower on Thursday as the yen's strength against the dollar triggered active selling by local investors, traders said.
Prices were 150 to 340 yen lower, with the benchmark November 1997 contract down 150 yen at 13,660 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 59,217 lots.
Active selling emerged from the opening, as individual investors were discouraged by the yen's gains against the dollar, traders said.
Some investors, who hold many long positions, rushed to sell actively throughout the day, they said.
